reviews.author: Shanu Khandelwal
reviews.text:
Beautiful Views, Disappointing Food – A Really Bad Dining Experience at NEKTR

The views at NEKTR are absolutely amazing, and the ambience is beautiful. Unfortunately, the food was nowhere close to what we expected, making it a very disappointing experience.

Here’s what went wrong with almost everything we ordered:

* Malai Broccoli: Loaded with cardamom and so sweet that it tasted more like a dessert than a savoury starter.
* Chicken Coriander Soup: Just chicken broth with barely two tiny pieces of chicken. Extremely disappointing.
* Tofu Tom Kha Soup: Essentially spicy coconut milk with just two micro-mini tofu dumplings. There was hardly anything substantial in it.
* Dark Chocolate Mousse: The worst part of the meal. It tasted more like chocolate halwa than mousse, and to make matters worse, it wasn’t even served cold.

The food was so disappointing that we eventually gave up on NEKTR and walked to the Biryani Zone in the next building for our main course.

While the view is undoubtedly beautiful, a great ambience cannot compensate for such poor food quality and execution. We came expecting a wonderful dining experience but left thoroughly disappointed.

NEKTR has a beautiful setting, but the food definitely needs serious improvement. Not an experience we would want to repeat.
